shortDescription: Resource module for Network Device Images Validations

options.name: cli
options.description: Show commands that will be executed. Validate the CLI - Cisco DevNet https //developer.cisco.com/docs/dna-center/2-3-7/run-read-only-commands...

options.name: description
options.description: Details of the network device validation.

options.name: dnac_debug
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable debugging.

options.name: dnac_password
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center password to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_username
options.description: The Cisco DNA Center username to authenticate.

options.name: dnac_verify
options.description: Flag to enable or disable SSL certificate verification.

options.name: dnac_version
options.description: Informs the SDK which version of Cisco DNA Center to use.

options.name: id
options.description: Id path parameter. Unique identifier of network device validation.

options.name: name
options.description: Name of the network device validation.

options.name: operationType
options.description: The operation type, as part of which this validation will get triggered.

options.name: productSeriesOrdinals
options.description: The custom check will be mapped to the product series and devices that belong to this series. These devices will consume this check when triggered. Fetch productSeriesOrdinal from API `/dna/intent/api/v1/productSeries`.

options.name: type
options.description: The type of network device validation determines whether this validation runs before or after the operation.

options.name: validate_response_schema
options.description: Flag for Cisco DNA Center SDK to enable the validation of request bodies against a JSON schema.
